description: A relayed unconfirmed transaction is evicted from the mempool. Per spec/ordering-rules.md §4 the relay rebroadcasts up to relay_rebroadcast_max times, then escalates to RECOVERY_RECOMMENDED. Re-acceptance into the mempool resets nothing but produces no action.
notes: status strings map to chain.TxStatus; expected_events to chain.EventKind. Consumed by apps/relay-go/tests/adversarial/vectors_test.go driving the real chain.Tracker.
